description: Held-out multi-phase checkout flow with new wording and ordering: UI copy first, then checkout API, webhook, migration, verification, deploy, done. Forces loads and unloads including stripe look-alike switches.

events.text: Rewrite the cart checkout button copy so buyers understand they are heading to secure payment. Copy changes only, no backend.
Copy merged. Next: build the server endpoint that creates the hosted payment session from our catalog prices.
Checkout endpoint live. Provider now sends completion callbacks; handle retries and repeated deliveries without double-charging.
Webhook stable. New requirement: store buyer contact fields with the order; extend the schema compatibly before the next deploy.
Schema extended. Write the regression plan: session creation errors, forged callback signatures, redelivered callbacks, leaked fields in logs.
Regression green. Assemble the go-live checklist: secrets, migration order, smoke probes, rollback. No deploy.
Work finished and session is closing. No package content needed further.
